name: wake-word-detector
description: Voice-activated wake word detection for 'Hey Claude'

scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.dist: npm run build-packager && npm run post-build
scripts.build-packager: npm run build && electron-packager . "Wake Word Detector" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --app-copyright="Copyright (C) 2025 Traves Theberge" --app-version="1.0.0" --executable-name="Claude-Wake-Word-Detector" --icon="assets/Install.ico"
scripts.post-build: echo. && echo ✅ Build completed! && echo. && echo 🚀 Next steps: && echo   1. Run scripts\Install-Shortcuts.bat to create desktop and start menu shortcuts && echo   2. Launch the application from the shortcuts or directly from release folder && echo   3. Configure your Picovoice API key in Settings && echo.
scripts.clean: if exist dist rmdir /s /q dist && if exist release rmdir /s /q release

author: Traves Theberge
